method: 214 diagrams / 428 full-page light and dark captures inspected in 27 full-height contact sheets, plus original-size main and complex examples. This records actual image inspection separately from native automated browser receipts.
limitation: 联系表用于布局、箭头方向、交叉、图例、卡片和下方区域复核，不能证明全部标签均被逐字审读；字体容纳和可读性另由原生 Edge 浏览器测量。滚动时 Viewer 工具条固定在视口边缘，全页截图中它可能暂时覆盖局部，可正常滚动或聚焦阅读。

findings.description: One position-only placement pass reduced resolved crossovers from 11 to 2; final light/dark captures reviewed. Remaining crossovers use the renderer crossover convention.
